Overview

F29 is a full-size high-output electric off-road motorcycle with a permanent-magnet synchronous motor, 72V60Ah battery and ECO, Sport and Race riding modes.

Permanent-magnet motor29 kW maximum power with 580 N·m wheel torque.
72V60Ah batteryUp to 120 km under the stated ≤50 km/h test condition.
Long-travel suspension838 mm front and 509 mm rear shock absorbers.
Dual disc brakesFront and rear disc brakes with 21/18-inch off-road tires.
